'''Adopt-A-Wampa''' was a business located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A sign with the business' name on it was also put up inside the [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]] diner, in order to promote Adopt-A-Wampa and attract potential visitors. It was named after the [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]],<ref name="MIA" /> a furry predator from the ice planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|creature|wampa|wampa ice creature}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Other bizarre signage in Pons Ora is the Admiral Snackbar (with the warning "It's a Frap"), Land O' Capes, Dr. Evazan Cosmetic Surgery, Abafar Junior Dejarik Club (No Wookiees), Game Go and Adopt-a-Wampa.|Missing in Action Trivia Gallery on StarWars.com|<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/missing-in-action-trivia-gallery|text="Missing in Action" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 12}}</ref>}}
Adopt-a-Wampa first appeared in "[[Missing in Action]]," the twelfth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="MIA" />
